curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: read decodable and non- decodable words featuring the targetsoundsfor fluency

interactions.prompt: Blend /s/ /o/ /p/. Which word do you hear?
interactions.feedback: Yes! The sounds blend to make soap.
interactions.retryHint: Say the sounds slowly, then slide them together.

interactions.prompt: Some words must be remembered by sight. Which card says 'the'?
interactions.feedback: Correct! The is a common word we learn to recognise quickly.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the short word with three letters: t-h-e.

interactions.prompt: Match each word to its reading clue.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its clue.
interactions.feedback: Great! You used sounds and sight memory to read.
interactions.retryHint: Check the first sound; remember the as a whole word.

interactions.prompt: Tap the word 'queen' in the sentence: The queen has soap.
interactions.feedback: You found queen quickly and accurately!
interactions.retryHint: Find the word that begins with qu.

interactions.prompt: Read, then arrange these words to match the sentence you heard: 'The queen has soap.'
interactions.feedback: Smooth reading! You recognised every word in the sentence.
interactions.retryHint: Start with the sight word The.

interactions.prompt: Choose both words you can read in: The queen has soap.
interactions.feedback: Reading star! You read the target words accurately.
interactions.retryHint: Look closely at every letter, then blend the sounds.
